name: Lightened
description: The shield has -1 Bulk and -1 Quality.

name: Fortified
description: The shield has +1 Bulk and +1 Quality.

name: Spiked
description: When the wielder parries a valid attack with this shield, the attacker risks damage as though the wielder parried with spikes from the Spiky trait.

name: Trick
description: The shield may change shape into a weapon, chosen upon taking this modifier, and back. This costs 1 Stamina. Its Bulk is equal to the higher of the two forms. The weapon's Quality is 1, plus any bonuses to shield Quality from other modifiers.

name: Pragmatic
description: This shield counts as a particular tool as well, chosen when applying this modifier, and Quality equal to its shield Quality, to a minimum of 1.

name: Balanced
description: When used to bash, this shield becomes a viable weapon. A shield with 2+ Bulk deals 4 damage, a shield with 1 Bulk deals 3 damage, a Light shield deals 2 damage. The weapon Quality of a shield used to attack in this way is equal to 1 plus any bonuses to the shield's Quality from Modifiers or effects.

name: Reflective
description: This shield may parry spells (and other spell-like attacks) and grants its bearer a single reroll when parrying spells or making an opposed Insight check to resist a magical effect.
